likely_cause: A real source stopped or a search-time index filter hid events; the predict() bound already allows weekend seasonality
tool_plan: Compare index and sourcetype volume vs the 7-day baseline; check UF tcpin; check HEC silence
splunk_web_path: Settings > Monitoring Console is not required — use this app's Data Topology and HEC views

likely_cause: This index's last complete hour is far below its own 7-day moving average
tool_plan: Confirm maintenance windows; list forwarders and HEC tokens that write this index; check last data time
splunk_web_path: Settings > Indexes (Cloud: Settings > Indexes) then the source system

likely_cause: One input on this host stopped while the host is still sending other data
tool_plan: Break the host volume by sourcetype vs the prior 24 hours; check monitor stanzas and blocked queues
splunk_web_path: Settings > Data inputs on the forwarder; do not edit inputs.conf from this dashboard

likely_cause: A previously busy HEC input sent nothing in the learned silence window
tool_plan: Confirm the HEC input is enabled; check sender logs and network; inspect HttpInputDataHandler errors
splunk_web_path: Settings > Data inputs > HTTP Event Collector

likely_cause: Universal forwarder is phoning home but no customer events are being indexed
tool_plan: Check outputs.conf target; indexer acknowledgement; transforms that drop; destination index existence
splunk_web_path: Forwarder outputs.conf and queue status — restart only after change control

likely_cause: The endpoint is not phoning home and not sending indexed data
tool_plan: Check host power network and splunkd service; confirm the IP still exists
splunk_web_path: Forwarder management / deployment server — restart only after change control

likely_cause: A splunkd health feature reported yellow or red on this instance
tool_plan: Open the feature on that host; check disk buckets and splunkd logs; do not clear the health report from this dashboard
splunk_web_path: Use this app's executive instance health table then inspect that host

likely_cause: Search or parsing load is saturating this instance CPU
tool_plan: List expensive searches; pause non-essential scheduled searches; add search capacity after change control
splunk_web_path: Job inspector and Settings > Searches; do not kill searches from this dashboard

likely_cause: SC4S or syslog path is logging errors or connection refused
tool_plan: Check collector process destination port and TLS; confirm the destination index still exists
splunk_web_path: SC4S Syslog dashboard in this app then the collector host

likely_cause: Edge/Ingest Processor queue is filling or export is erroring
tool_plan: Inspect pipelines for blocked destinations and filter rules that drop all events
splunk_web_path: SC4S Syslog and Edge dashboard in this app

likely_cause: No events were indexed in the last 15 minutes across exec_health_idx
tool_plan: Check UF phone-home HEC syslog listeners and whether exec_health_idx is too narrow
splunk_web_path: Data Topology and the executive live-events tile

likely_cause: Yesterday license GB is below the 7-day moving average
tool_plan: Compare indexes and sourcetypes for the drop; confirm maintenance or a retired source
splunk_web_path: License usage and Data Topology in this app
